$comment: p95 budgets in ms per case (cases.ts) and mode, checked by run.ts --check; the CI job perf-reports fails when a p95 is over its budget.

Set on 2026-10-24 from the worst p95 of every run on the current code: eight warm runs (five local on a 2 CPU / 8 GB container, three in CI, two of those beside a full merge request pipeline) and six mixed (three local, three CI). For compute_prior_opening_balances and the huvudbok account page only the runs after !845 and the page-boundary change count.

warm: twice the worst p95 (at least 10 ms) while that stays within the 100 ms DB target; 100 ms when 1.5 times the worst still fits under it; otherwise 1.5 times the worst, rounded up to 10 ms, and the case carries a note.
mixed: twice the worst mixed p95, at least 20 ms, rounded up to 10 ms. Mixed has no absolute target: it catches calls that slow down under concurrent postings and builds.
The 100 ms DB target: 200 ms p95 end to end, less the auth proxy and route wrapper (50-90 ms in production).
A change that makes a call legitimately slower raises its budget in the same merge request, with before and after numbers.

hem.verifikat_without_documents.note: Over the 100 ms target: supplier_invoices_with_document joins document_attachments by id with no company filter, so the planner scans every company's documents; it grows with the whole database, not the company.

bookkeeping.list_verifikat_missing_under.note: Over the 100 ms target: the same id joins without a company filter (document_attachments, supplier_invoice_payments, invoices) scan every company's rows.

dimension_cross.buckets.note: Not yet measured on the bench (accounted#133, 2026-10-31): set to the 100 ms target and dimension_pnl.buckets' mixed budget. Production on 2026-10-31: the line path took 51 ms warm for the company with the most two-dimension lines and 431 ms for a 70 000-line year, hence ledger_tagset_days; its rows read like ledger_dimension_days (47 700 rows in about 80 ms). Replace with twice the first scheduled run's worst p95.

dimension_cross.cell_lines.note: Not yet measured on the bench (accounted#133, 2026-10-31); same rule as dimension_cross.buckets. The cell is read through its first value's locator.

audit.sources.month.note: Near the target: 43 ms on a quiet host, up to 91 ms on a busy runner, so the budget sits above it.

audit.sources.year.note: The whole-year behandlingshistorik, over the target by decision (the report opens on the month, docs/decisions/2026-10/2026-10-23-behandlingshistorik-opens-on-month.md).
